2. appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE LITTLE
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The little helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE LITTLE
Study The little like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The little” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The little in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The little is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The little” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The little in your own words. (skill: appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The little to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●.
4. Make one local Kenya example of The little from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The little: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study The little?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The little means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the miracle of the five loaves and five loaves and two fish to feed the Christ fish two fish and practice kindness to others ●.
5. Be able to: appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and ●.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
